title: Publish andrewboldi/skills
description: Create the public repo, push code and beads data, set About and topics, check CI and the three install routes from the published URLs.

title: CI: lint, skill checks, plugin validation, installer tests
description: GitHub Actions: shellcheck, SKILL.md frontmatter checks, claude plugin validate, the installer against a temp HOME on Linux and macOS, and a napkin scaffold smoke test.

title: One-command installer for every coding agent
description: install.sh copies the skills into the skills folder of each agent it finds (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot, pi); re-run updates; --uninstall removes only what it installed. Plus .claude-plugin/marketplace.json for Claude Code's plugin installer.
close_reason: install.sh copies the skills into every agent it finds, re-runs update, --uninstall removes only marked copies; tests/install-test.sh (20 checks, mutation-checked); .claude-plugin/marketplace.json validates

title: README, logo and docs for the skills repo
description: README following hn-ready's recipe, a hand-written SVG logo, LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING (bd required), docs/install-manually.md and docs/caveats.md.
close_reason: README (83 lines, hn-ready's recipe), hand-written logo checked at 132 px on light and dark, LICENSE (MIT), CONTRIBUTING with the bd requirement, docs/install-manually.md, docs/caveats.md, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md

title: Test both skills end to end in Codex and opencode
description: Only Claude Code is tested end to end. The installer puts the skills where Codex (~/.agents/skills) and opencode (~/.config/opencode/skills) look, but nobody has run a real session in them yet.

title: Demo GIF: a real hn-ready run
description: Record Claude Code running hn-ready on a small test repo from a clean profile, sped up to about 30 s. Check every frame for anything personal.
close_reason: Real Claude Code run from a clean profile (env -i, no inherited CLAUDE_CODE_* variables, notices pre-seen): skill loads, audits, hands back 13 numbered proposals. 31 s, 1.4 MB; every frame checked. Recipe in ~/skills-launch/demo (outside the repo)

title: Build the napkin template in CI
description: The napkin skill's tools/check.sh builds the template with latexmk and self-tests its log checks. CI only scaffolds a book today; installing enough TeX Live to build it would make the template's build a tested promise.
